name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Bauer, Forge, Europa, and Diatoms belong to different colonists.
Echo goes with exactly two of Bauer, Titan, and Plankton.
Anders, Luna, and Algae belong to different colonists.
Echo goes with neither Europa nor Luna.
Bauer, Drift, Titan, and Algae belong to different colonists.
Drift goes with exactly two of Cho, Titan, and Diatoms.
